title: Ceiling of the triplets: memory M = 41, 51 and pruning of the M = 51 pool
question: Where does the growth of the T3 + FIR triplets with memory M stop, and how many terms keep the large-M quality?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
memory_note: M = 51: 3 979 terms, normal matrix 3 986^2 complex per file (~0.25 GB x 30 files)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.memory: growth continues if M = 51 - M = 31 (E034) >= 1 p.p. (test mean, 5 replicas)
rule_draft.pruning: K = 2048 terms keep >= 95 % of the reduction of the full M = 51 model

M_note: the full M = 51 model is the 'full' row of the pruning stage (prune_M = 51), not refitted
